text: Alberto Oculista is the brand of Alberto Oculista, SA, a Madeira opticians retail chain founded in 1984 by Alberto Caires; in the CEO's message on the company site, Miguel Caires says the company remains 100% owned by the family that founded it.
short: Alberto Oculista, SA says it remains 100% owned by the founding Caires family.

source.name: Alberto Oculista: Mensagem da Administração
source.quote: A empresa continua a 100% na família que a fundou. O fundador, Alberto Caires, é o Presidente do Conselho de Administração
source.note: CEO message (by Miguel Caires, 'CEO Alberto Oculista, S.A'), undated; site footer identifies the company as 'Alberto Oculista, SA'.
